26285.en: X_26285 is the complement of X_10525.
re: X(26285 ) = reflection of X_1482 in X_11567
no: See Antreas Hatzipolakis and Ercole Suppa, `Hyacinthos 28557 <http://www.hyacinthos.epizy.com/message.php?msg=28557>`__.

Let A'B'C' be the medial triangle. Let L_{A} be the reflection of line B'C' in the internal angle bisector of A, and define L_{B} and L_{C} cyclically. Let A" = L_{B} ∩ L_{C}, B" = L_{C} ∩ L_{A}, C" = L_{A} ∩ L_{B}. A"B"C" is the mid-triangle of the intangents and tangential triangles. A"B"C" is homothetic to the intangents, extangents, and tangential triangles at X_55, and to the Kosnita triangle at X_26285. (Randy Hutson, June 7, 2019)
